description: Massive reference data: full stock split history, the complete published cash dividend history and the stock ticker directory (active and delisted; primary exchange MIC, CIK, composite/share-class FIGI, delisting dates); canonical authorized-feed JSONL imports remain supported

source.license_notes: Massive (formerly Polygon.io) Stocks Basic plan: individual, non-professional use only; no redistribution of raw or derived price data. Keep artifacts local.

sampling.reason: Nasdaq Daily List documents issue and symbol changes; licensed feed access, dated records and adjustment policy are not configured. No corporate action history acquired.
sampling.criteria: Availability only; no reconstructed split/dividend/symbol-change history.

coverage.scope: Massive split history, complete dividend history and stock ticker directory (active and delisted)

acquisition.description: Cursor (next_url) pagination over /v3/reference/splits, /v3/reference/tickers (market=stocks, active=true then false) and /v3/reference/dividends (complete published history, newest ex-dividend date first), 1000 rows per page, 5 requests/minute shared with market_prices. Combination order puts splits and the ticker directory (the identity crosswalk: primary exchange MIC, CIK, FIGI) before the dividend history, and dividends descend from the newest ex-date, so any stop truncates the oldest dividends rather than the crosswalk or recent actions. desired_bytes 3,000,000,000 bytes (2.79 GiB, under the 5 GiB per-dataset cap): the plan's 110 MB estimate was low (dividends alone exceed it at ~250 KB per 1,000-row page) and the full dividend history length is unknown, so the ceiling is set generously. Alpaca /v1/corporate-actions (mergers, spin-offs, symbol changes) is not included: it needs a separate host and symbol lists.
